summary: One government page says 30 EEA countries. Another says 31 EEA States. Both sentences stay.

sides.quotation: Citizens of all 30 countries have the right to move freely throughout the EEA
The EEA Agreement provides for the inclusion of EU legislation covering the four freedoms — the free movement of goods, services, persons and capital — throughout the 31 EEA States.

summary: The same release prints a 12% heading and an 8% sentence for the growth in service imports. Both stay.

sides.quotation: Imports of services increased by 12% between years
In 2024, the total value of service imports was 55.4 billion ISK higher than in 2023, representing an 8% increase at current exchange rates.

summary: The ownership page says shareholders are around 800 and does not date that sentence. The fact sheet dated 31 December 2025 says the number amounts to approximately 819. Both print a 98.2% state holding.

sides.quotation: Landsbankinn's shareholders are around 800 with the National Treasury as the largest owner of a 98.2% share.
